sources.title: Monitor wildlife health via image classification - Colab
sources.snippet: Train an image classifier (~2 hours to complete, costs ~$25.00): With some desired criteria, a Dataflow pipeline creates a balanced dataset from the metadata database. It then physically downloads the necessary images from LILA into Cloud Storage, imports the data into AI Platform Unified, and starts the model training job.
